WITH obs_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) as total, COUNT(*) as num_obs
  FROM obs_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT
    oc.count,
    CAST(oc.count AS REAL) / gt.total as share,
    1.0 / gt.num_obs as avg_share
  FROM obs_counts oc, grand_total gt
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT count, share, avg_share
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT
  AVG(count) as avg_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_share_deviation
FROM filtered;
